title: 3.3 Score Grade
prompt: 3.3 Write a program to prompt for a score between 0.0 and 1.0. If the score is out of range, print an error. If the score is between 0.0 and 1.0, print a grade using the table A/B/C/D/F. For the test, enter a score of 0.85.

OutputTests.test_desired_output.title: Matches desired output
OutputTests.test_desired_output.feedback: Compare your program output carefully to the Desired Output.

SourceTests.test_source_input.title: Source check: require 'input'
SourceTests.test_source_input.feedback: You must prompt for the score using the input() function.

SourceTests.test_source_float.title: Source check: require 'float'
SourceTests.test_source_float.feedback: You should use the built-in float() function to convert from a string to a float.

SourceTests.test_source_print.title: Source check: require 'print'
SourceTests.test_source_print.feedback: You must use the print function to print the output.

SourceTests.test_source_if.title: Source check: require 'if'
SourceTests.test_source_if.feedback: You should use an if statement to check the value of the score.

SourceTests.test_source_elif.title: Source check: require 'elif'
SourceTests.test_source_elif.feedback: One of the learning objectives of this assignment is to use an elif statement when checking the value of the score.
